notes.title: Update Notes for July 11th
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where users with Oculus/Meta operated OpenXR would not see their hands / controllers



Note: If the issue persists, please try to set SteamVR as your OpenXR runtime:

Launch SteamVR.

Open the SteamVR menu

Click on Settings

Go to OpenXR tab

Click "Set SteamVR as OpenXR Runtime" if it’s not already set.
